EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in the PhD in Family and Human Development at ASU!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in the Family and Human Development PhD program at the T. Denny Sanford School of Social and Family Dynamics! Please review the program handbook for information on the admission process, courses offered, plan of study, dissertation details and more.
Applications for the next academic year are accepted from September 1 to January 15. Application reviews begin in early January. Please visit the program's website for any updates.
Once you have reviewed the handbook, please email me with any questions you may have.
Start your application today.
Thank you and we look forward to hearing from you!
Gina Perez, M.Ed. Graduate Programs Coordinator T. Denny Sanford School of Social and Family Dynamics {!Case.Thread_Id}
